description:
This file defines a React component for a file preview modal in a web application, enabling users to view, rename, and manage files.
It includes UI elements, event handlers, and integrations with application state and external components.

methods.name: keyDownHandler
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation and closing the modal, supporting arrow keys and escape.

methods.name: handleRename
methods.description: Renames the current file if a new name is provided.

methods.name: toggleOptionsMenu
methods.description: Toggles the display of the file options menu.

methods.name: toggleInfoPanel
methods.description: Toggles the display of the file information panel.

methods.name: toggleLinkedBubblesContainer
methods.description: Shows or hides the container for linked items related to the current file.
